changes.title: Badlands trees
items: The badlands grow a few more kinds of tree: hawthorns and pines among the junipers, which now have leafy skirts below their crowns

changes.title: Dragonfly crab
items: Two new animals for the mangrove swamp islands: the dragonfly, darting and hovering over dark pools among the mangroves, and the fiddler crab, scuttling sideways across the mudflats
Their legends: a dragonfly that is all eye and wing, and a crab with one colossal gleaming claw it waves to beckon you

changes.title: Lion
items: A new creature for the hot south: the lion, a big tawny cat with a dark mane and a tufted tail, and its own area, the Savanna: tall gold grass under flat-topped acacias and baobabs, a kopje of sun-warmed boulders
The lion's legend, asleep in the long grass, gives Lion's Pride: 💌s fly a little faster and further
